insights.one_liner: Small London-based recruitment agency placing finance, HR and investment staff, also recruiting in the Netherlands; an agency, not the end employer.

culture.text: Boutique recruitment consultancy of about 9 people on LinkedIn, founded in 2016 by Ann Radford and headquartered in London.
Recruits for finance and accounting, private equity, HR and investment management roles in the UK and the Netherlands.

open.text: Not on the IND list of recognised visa sponsors.
Its one open job here, a finance manager role in the Amsterdam area, needs no Dutch; it drew 76 LinkedIn applicants on average.
